Start the app once with your plugins skipped. Required plugins still run, and your plugin settings are untouched, so you can disable the broken plugin in Vencord \u2192 Plugins. Plugins that are still enabled come back the next time you start the app normally.

Vendroid is an unofficial, modified Discord client. Before you use it, please understand what you are accepting:

1. Third-party code
This app loads and runs the real Discord web app, plus third-party client code (Vencord/Equicord, plugins, themes). That code is trusted but not fully under our control. If its source or update servers are ever compromised, malicious code could run inside your Discord session with access to your account and device.

2. Modified client
Using a modified Discord client violates Discord's Terms of Service and can result in your account being banned.

3. Not official
This is not made or endorsed by Discord. We provide no guarantee or warranty.

By tapping "I understand", you accept these risks. If you are not comfortable with them, uninstall the app instead.
